content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Engineering Professionals recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and make the payment for RITES Engineering Professionals recruitment is 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for RITES Engineering Professionals posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for most of the Engineering Professionals posts at RITES is a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering. Specific experience requirements vary for each post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Engineering Professionals at RITES?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for Engineering Professionals posts at RITES. These vacancies are distributed across various positions like DGM, Manager, and Assistant Manager.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 600/- plus applicable taxes. For EWS/SC/ST/PWD candidates, the fee is Rs. 300/- plus applicable taxes. Payment is to be made online.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to RITES Engineering Professionals posts?
faq.answer: The age limit varies for different posts, with the maximum age for DGM/Contract Specialist being 41 years, for Managers 35 years, and for Assistant Managers 32 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for RITES Engineering Professionals recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for RITES Engineering Professionals recruitment typically includes Document Scrutiny, Written Test, and Interview. Candidates are shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Engineering Professionals posts at RITES?
faq.answer: The salary offered varies depending on the post. For DGM/Contract Specialist, it ranges from INR 70,000-2,00,000. For Managers, it is INR 50,000-1,60,000, and for Assistant Managers, it is INR 40,000-1,40,000.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, RITES recruitment is open for candidates Across India. The job type is regular basis, and the organization is Rail India Technical and Economic Service.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted during the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring duly filled Annexure A and all relevant documents in chronological order at the time of Document Verification/Selection process. This includes educational certificates, experience certificates, and identity proof.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article. You can also visit the official RITES website for more details and to apply online.
